description: This file contains unit tests for the LocalizationDao class related to I18N (internationalization) features in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup procedures, test cases for searching languages, counting languages, getting language details, saving language data, retrieving translations, grouping, deleting languages, and handling import errors.
